notes.message: The variant paints the Track only while checked: background = checked ? switchVariantBackground[variant] : 'bgTertiary' (Switch.tsx L119). Off is bgTertiary in every variant, so Positive and Negative Off draw as Primary Off. Those 10 tuples stay in the selection; the owner can omit them in To-preview.

Switch renders through Control, whose Interactable is a div wrapping the hidden input and the Track (Control.tsx L169-L201). Hover and Active take Interactable's :hover and :active rules (Interactable.tsx L49-L64): the background blends of transparent stay transparent, and the children dim. Disabled sets aria-disabled on that div (Interactable.tsx L244), which [aria-disabled='true'] styles; a div never matches :disabled. Control uses no Pressable, so nothing scales while pressed.

The focus ring is Control's interactableCss outline while the input inside has :focus-visible (Control.tsx L53-L59): 2px solid bgPrimary, offset 1px outside the Control's 1px border. The Contract draws it as a 2px outside stroke on the Control, with no gap. A spread drop shadow could keep the gap, but bgPrimary has no EFFECT_COLOR scope, so an effect cannot bind it (validation rule 6). To-preview forces Focus with the class it puts on every element, so the page draws the same outline.

Interactable's default borderWidth = 100 (Interactable.tsx L209) gives the Control a 1px border, transparent in every state: transparentWhileInactiveCss (L100-L108), and the hover, pressed and disabled blends of transparent are transparent. On the page the Control is 54 x 34 around the 52 x 32 Track. Figma's inside stroke takes no room, so the Control hugs the Track at 52 x 32; nothing visible moves.

The thumb's slide is drawn at its end positions: Off at the Track's start, On at its end, as trackCss [data-filled='true'] justify-content: flex-end does (Switch.tsx L41-L43). CDS places the thumb absolutely at top and left (switchHeight - switchThumbSize) / 2 = 1px (L51-L55) and moves it by x = switchWidth - switchHeight = 20px when checked (L96-L105), animated with switchTransitionConfig (switch.ts L6-L9); the Track's background-color fades over 0.2s (Switch.tsx L37-L39). Figma has no animation. The Thumb sits in the Track's flow inside its 1px padding, which puts it where CDS's end positions do.

The thumb is defaultControlColor: fgInverse in Light, fg in Dark (Switch.tsx L131). No one Theme colour holds it in both Modes, so it binds the Synthesized token switch-thumb-background (ADR 0009), which the Foundations step reads from Switch.tsx. controlColor (L160) replaces it, and elevation (L164) adds a shadow; the Contract draws neither.

With a label, Control wraps the switch and the label Text in a label element: a row with gap={1} (Control.tsx L243), the switch centred in a Box as tall as the body line (L244). Switch gives its root alignItems center and a minHeight of switchHeight when it has children (Switch.tsx L176-L183). The Contract draws one centred row with gap space-1. The label is fgMuted unless checked (Control.tsx L137), in the body font (L146).

The Label is always drawn. A Switch without children renders no label element (Control.tsx L236), and CDS's own Figma component hides it with a show label boolean (Switch.figma.ts L9). The Contract has no property that can drop a text prop, only an icon swap, so a Switch without a label is the same Component with its Label text cleared.

Props that override the drawing are not axes: controlColor, background, borderColor, borderWidth and borderRadius (Switch.tsx L115-L122), and elevation. readOnly draws as Disabled: Control disables its Interactable for disabled || readOnly (Control.tsx L177). indeterminate only changes the label colour (L137), and a switch has no indeterminate drawing.

CDS's own Code Connect file (Switch.figma.ts) maps checked and disabled (L13-L14), emits checked={false} when off (L21), and has no variant. The Contract follows Switch.tsx: the variant prop (L78) as an axis, checked set only when on, and disabled through the State axis. The Contract imports Switch from @coinbase/cds-web/controls. That subpath is the exports map's ./controls (package.json L99-L102).
